content.what_it_is: Python/NumPy/Matplotlib translation of a rip-case frame plotter. It derives a case output directory from HOME (L13-L14), loads dep.out and builds a dx=1,dy=2 mesh (L22-L35), asks for an inclusive integer frame range (L37-L44), loads/masks eta, depth, and mean velocity fields per frame (L47-L60), draws elevation and depth/quiver subplots, and saves/shows one PNG per frame (L62-L93).
entities: hp elevation artist and h_bar colorbar @L66-L71
unresolved: `dep` is loaded only once at L23 and mutated under each frame mask at L58. Dry cells from any earlier frame remain NaN in later frames even if later masks mark them wet, so depth masking accumulates across the frame loop.

There is no figure clear/close or axes reset in the loop L44-L93. Repeated subplot calls reuse axes while each iteration adds pcolor/contour/quiver artists and new colorbar axes, so multi-frame runs accumulate graphics state and colorbars and can distort later saved images and memory use.
Both panels restrict x to `m*dx/2` at L67 and L90 although arrays span x=0 through approximately m*dx at L31; the reason for discarding the second half of the domain is unstated.
HOME is indexed directly at L13 (KeyError if absent), input conversion has no validation, and array shapes are not checked before common masking/plotting.
